requirements: Add bin/check.js <file> [--check]: print each problem parseConfig reports for the file, then the entry count. With --check the process must also end with exit status 1 when parseConfig reports any problem, so that CI fails on a malformed file. CI always supplies the file argument.

defects.consequence: No problem parseConfig reports starts with 'error', so --check exits 0 on a malformed file and CI passes it.
defects.origin: Ready parser check passes with structural errors

decoys.consequence: Comment lines are reported as problems, so a commented file fails the check.
decoys.evidence: src/config.js:5 comments are counted as problems
decoys.reason: parseConfig returns early for lines starting with #, so comments are never reported.
